$comment: GET /info{endpoint} for every DbResource this SDK knows, on both products, captured read-only in one session. /info returns the server's own JSON Schema for an endpoint - it is schema, never model data, and no GET response body is included. This is a baseline: diffing a later capture against it is how a product patch's effect on the API surface gets measured. The 2026-09-02 patch was checked this way against 26 endpoints and changed none of them; this file widens that comparison to every endpoint that answers.

coverage.note: /info is served for /db/* only. Every /DESIGN/* pair 404s, which is an API fact rather than a URL bug - see CLAUDE.md. The three /db/* exceptions are the Civil Hyper-S trio /db/IEHG-GL-M1, /db/IEHG-PSS-M1 and /db/IEHG-TRUSS-M1.
